notes: Paper presents constraints on axion decay constant f_a vs axion mass m_a from reanalysis of existing 40K electron capture and 137Cs beta decay data at Gran Sasso Laboratory. The coupling type is AxionMass because the primary result is plotted in the (m_a, 1/f_a) plane, constraining the axion-gluon coupling through time modulation of weak nuclear decay rates induced by oscillating axion dark matter background. The bounds are: f_a > 1.0×10^14 GeV (at 2σ) for m_a = 3.0×10^-23 eV, and f_a > 3.2×10^10 GeV for m_a = 9.6×10^-20 eV. These represent mass-independent bounds over the stated mass range. The paper also proposes a future 40K measurement reaching sensitivities to m_a up to 10^-9 eV (shown as yellow cross-hatched projection in Fig. 3, not included in data_points as it is a projection). DM density of 0.45 GeV/cm³ is used in the standard misalignment calculation (Eq. 4.1), typical for galactic halo DM searches. Confidence level is 2σ (≈95%).
